summary: ADC Therapeutics SA filed an 8-K on June 24, 2026, announcing a global workforce reduction of approximately 17% driven by the expected completion of LOTIS-5 and LOTIS-7 trials and operational efficiencies. The company expects annualized cost savings of roughly $10 million and one-time pre-tax charges of about $3 million for severance and related costs, mostly recognized in Q2 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a voluntary operational restructuring, not a court-supervised proceeding. Watch for execution risk and potential further cost actions as the company streamlines operations post-trial completions.
